title: Symmetrizations of Ball-Bodies
summary: We study symmetrization procedures within the class $\mathcal S_n$ of \emph{ball-bodies}, i.e.\ intersections of unit Euclidean balls (equivalently, summands of the Euclidean unit ball, or $c$-convex sets via the $c$-duality $A\mapsto A^c$). We first examine linear parameter systems obtained by replacing the usual convex hull by the $c$-hull $A^{cc}$, deriving consequences for volume along these $c$-paths.
